description: SLO: the error-rate recording rule orders_api:error_rate:5m exists — the SLI is precomputed from the golden-signal metric, not hand-queried per incident
command: grep -Eq 'record:[[:space:]]*orders_api:error_rate:5m' observability/prometheus/rules/slo-orders.yml && echo pass || echo fail

description: SLO: the latency recording rule orders_api:latency_p95:5m exists — p95 is a golden signal computed from the request-duration histogram
command: grep -Eq 'record:[[:space:]]*orders_api:latency_p95:5m' observability/prometheus/rules/slo-orders.yml && echo pass || echo fail

description: ERROR BUDGET: the SLOErrorBudgetBurn alert fires when error rate exceeds the 1% budget — the alert is a burn threshold, not a raw count
command: grep -A1 'alert:[[:space:]]*SLOErrorBudgetBurn' observability/prometheus/rules/slo-orders.yml | grep -Eq 'orders_api:error_rate:5m[[:space:]]*>[[:space:]]*0\.01' && echo pass || echo fail

description: SLO: the latency SLO threshold is 500ms (0.5s) — the objective is a named number the alert gates on, not a vibe
command: grep -A1 'alert:[[:space:]]*SLOLatencyBreach' observability/prometheus/rules/slo-orders.yml | grep -Eq 'orders_api:latency_p95:5m[[:space:]]*>[[:space:]]*0\.5' && echo pass || echo fail

description: GOLDEN SIGNALS: orders-api exports the four evidence metrics — request count (traffic+errors), duration histogram (latency), upstream errors — as real Prometheus series
command: grep -q 'orders_api_requests_total' app/orders-api/src/metrics.py && grep -q 'orders_api_request_duration_seconds' app/orders-api/src/metrics.py && grep -q 'orders_api_upstream_errors_total' app/orders-api/src/metrics.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: EVIDENCE: the upstream retry counter orders_api_upstream_retries_total exists — the retry storm is measurable, not inferred from logs alone
command: grep -q 'orders_api_upstream_retries_total' app/orders-api/src/metrics.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: ANTI-FIREHOSE: the SLI queries are bounded by a 5m rate window and aggregated (sum/by le) — a bounded question, not sum(everything)
command: grep -Eq 'rate\(orders_api_requests_total.*\[5m\]\)' observability/prometheus/rules/slo-orders.yml && echo pass || echo fail

description: RETRY STORM: the retry-storm fixture raises RETRY_COUNT to 10 and TIMEOUT_MS to 30000 — the causal change is the retry config, provable from the fixture, not a guess
command: grep -Eq 'RETRY_COUNT=10' fixtures/fault-configs/retry-storm.env && grep -Eq 'TIMEOUT_MS=30000' fixtures/fault-configs/retry-storm.env && echo pass || echo fail

description: MECHANISM: the inventory client retries retry_count+1 times with exponential backoff — 10 retries + a 30s timeout is an 11x upstream amplifier, readable in source
command: grep -Eq 'range\(self\.settings\.retry_count \+ 1\)' app/orders-api/src/inventory_client.py && grep -q '2 \*\* attempt' app/orders-api/src/inventory_client.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: EVIDENCE PACKET: a well-formed sre-investigator packet (hypothesis + sources + out_of_scope) validates — a claim with provenance is evidence, not decoration
command: printf '{"from_role":"sre-investigator","to_role":"ops-lead","evidence":{"service":"orders-api","status":"degraded","checks":{"healthz":true},"hypothesis":"retry config amplifies upstream latency into a storm","confidence":"high","sources":["fixtures/fault-configs/retry-storm.env","app/orders-api/src/inventory_client.py:20"]},"recommendations":["lower RETRY_COUNT"],"out_of_scope":["did not check DB saturation"]}' | bash scripts/evidence-validate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: PROVENANCE: an evidence packet with a confident hypothesis and NO sources is rejected (exit 4) — an assertion dressed as evidence is contamination
command: printf '{"from_role":"sre-investigator","to_role":"ops-lead","evidence":{"service":"orders-api","status":"down","checks":{},"hypothesis":"the database is out of memory","confidence":"high","sources":[]},"recommendations":[],"out_of_scope":[]}' | bash scripts/evidence-validate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 4 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: HYPOTHESIS SYNTHESIS: three independent dimensions that converge on the retry-config root cause from their OWN evidence yield verdict=corroborated — real agreement, not an echo
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["inventory_client.py:20"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"platform-resource","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"medium","sources":["kubectl top pods"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"recent-change","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["retry-storm.env"],"derived_from":null}]' | bash scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'verdict=corroborated' && echo pass || echo fail

description: FALSIFY, DON'T ECHO: a packet derived_from a peer's hypothesis (not its own evidence) is rejected as consensus theater (exit 4) — three echoes are one guess, not three confirmations
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["inventory_client.py:20"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"platform-resource","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["peer said so"],"derived_from":"application-retry"}]' | bash scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 4 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: AUTHORITY: the sre-investigator role has no Edit/Write tool — the investigator produces evidence and recommends a fix, it never applies one
command: grep -Eq 'disallowedTools:.*"Edit".*"Write"' .claude/agents/sre-investigator.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: ALERTING: alertmanager routes to a file/webhook receiver (no human paged in the lab) — alerts are captured as evidence, the routing is real
command: grep -Eq 'receiver:[[:space:]]*file-logger' observability/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR SKILL: .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md exists — the correlation procedure is an artifact the next investigation loads, not something re-derived under pressure
command: [ -f .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md ] && echo present || echo missing

description: YOUR SKILL: the description begins 'Use when' — the frontmatter is written as an invocation trigger, which is what makes a skill fire on relevance
command: [ -f .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -qE '^description: *Use when' .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md && echo triggered || echo untriggered

description: ANTI-FIREHOSE: no unbounded matchers, and raw counters are queried through a range selector — an unbounded query is a context flood, not evidence
command: [ -f .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; b=$(grep -oE '\[\$?\{?window\}?\]|\[[0-9]+[smh]\]' .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md | wc -l | tr -d ' '); u=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(Q |curl )' .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md | grep -c '__name__=~'); [ "$b" -ge 2 ] && [ "$u" -eq 0 ] && echo bounded || echo unbounded

description: YOUR SKILL: all four golden signals are named as queries — latency, traffic, errors, saturation
command: [ -f .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; ok=1; for k in latency_p95 requests_total error_rate upstream_retries; do grep -q "$k" .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md || ok=0; done; [ "$ok" -eq 1 ] && echo complete || echo incomplete

description: HONEST GAP: the skill declares that distributed traces are unavailable — a skill that silently omits a telemetry type will be trusted for a question it cannot answer
command: [ -f .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -qi 'trace' .claude/skills/alert-correlate/SKILL.md && echo declared || echo silent

description: YOUR PACKET: the evidence packet your agent produced passes evidence-validate.sh — same validator a human investigator's output must pass
command: [ -f agentops/incidents/inc-002-packet.json ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; scripts/evidence-validate.sh agentops/incidents/inc-002-packet.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo valid || echo invalid

description: PROVENANCE: every sources[] entry looks like a command that was run, not a sentence describing where you looked
command: [ -f agentops/incidents/inc-002-packet.json ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; jq -e '[.evidence.sources[] | test("curl|grep|diff|docker|jq|/")] | all and (length>0)' agentops/incidents/inc-002-packet.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo commands || echo prose

description: YOUR PACKET: out_of_scope is non-empty — it names what this investigation did not cover
command: [ -f agentops/incidents/inc-002-packet.json ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; jq -e '.out_of_scope | length > 0' agentops/incidents/inc-002-packet.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo declared || echo empty

description: NO CONSENSUS THEATER: every hypothesis carries derived_from null — three agents that read each other are one agent with extra steps
command: [ -f agentops/incidents/inc-002-hypotheses.json ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; jq -e '[.[] | .derived_from] | all(. == null)' agentops/incidents/inc-002-hypotheses.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo independent || echo derivative

description: SYNTHESIS: synthesize-hypotheses.sh accepts your three packets and returns a verdict — the existing script, unmodified, judging your agents' output
command: [ -f agentops/incidents/inc-002-hypotheses.json ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh agentops/incidents/inc-002-hypotheses.json 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^verdict=' && echo synthesized || echo rejected
